groupSizes.justification: Large and choice-heavy by design, under the Product Owner's explicit combat exception to the 5+ rule: a broad combat group is desirable precisely because it makes broad investment in one narrow competence domain economically viable. This is not an oversized group tolerated for breadth; it is the shape the ruling asks for. The pool crosses melee, throwing and unarmed, because a close-quarters school genuinely teaches the grapple and the thrown weapon alongside the sword. Combat Experience is absent: this is instruction, and instruction cannot confer what only real exposure teaches. Overlap with M01 and M03 is intentional; Profession breadth is deduplicated. Restores the historical Advanced Melee Training choose-three slot, and the recovered import's choose-2 reading is provenance only.

groupSizes.name: Swashbuckling fencing instruction

Where a Profession offers ordinary close combat instead of this tradition, that is an alternative Profession training route, not a choice inside this group.

groupSizes.name: Formation arms drill
groupSizes.justification: Large and choice-heavy by design, under the Product Owner's explicit combat exception to the 5+ rule: drilled competence in the arms a formation actually carries is worth buying as one course. Merges the three fixed formation groups: a soldier is charged for the arms actually issued and drilled, not for every weapon family the army fields. Brawling is absent — close-order drill is not an unarmed course.

groupSizes.name: Mounted lance and formation drill

groupSizes.name: Coercive service practice

directGrantPolicy: R1 — no generic instruction grant. Teaching is withdrawn wherever instructing others is not part of the occupation's own definition. Master artisans still reach it through C02, and Teachers through K07.

R2 — no generic commerce top-up. Trade, Appraisal and Bargaining are withdrawn wherever a Learning Group already supplies the family's commercial practice, or where selling one's output is not itself a taught practice.
R3 — no generic social polish. Customs is withdrawn wherever the curriculum has no social, ceremonial, courtly or cross-cultural element beyond ordinary life.

R4 — no generic learned top-up. History, Philosophy, Politics, Religion, Geography, Mathematics, Mnemonics and Insight are withdrawn wherever a learned group already supplies the grounding and the Skill is not the family's own subject matter.

R5 — no workshop garnish. Carpentry, Ropework, Mechanics and similar adjacent trades are withdrawn where they were decoration rather than taught craft, and kept where the material genuinely is the craft.

R7 — a coherent cluster belongs in a Learning Group. Where a family's direct grants described a practice that is genuinely taught and practised together, they were moved into a group rather than left as exceptional routes: the Guard's watch duty into K24, the Thief's street theft into K25, the Diviner's and Religious Practitioner's contemplative discipline into K22, and the Weapon Instructor's salle into M10. Direct grants are exceptional occupational routes, not a breadth mechanism.
R6 — a grant survives on coherence, never on arithmetic. Several retained grants leave their path at 7 or 8; that is an accepted outcome, not a defect to be corrected.

directGrantDecisions.rationale: Added by the 2026-09-21 Profession-cores ruling, which makes the direct Cooking route the cook's defining core and states that C10 is not it. Cooking is also taught inside C10, so the grant adds no breadth — overlapping routes are charged once — but it states the occupation's own defining practice as a route the cook always has, independently of the brewhouse curriculum.
R7. Knowing whose district this is was never an exception for a guard; it is the substance of watch duty, and it moved into K24 with the rest of it.
R7. Making someone stand down without drawing is taught on watch, not granted. Moved into K24. The Enforcer keeps it through K23, where it is coercion rather than keeping order.
R7. The thief's hands are the trade, not an exception to it. Moved into K25 with Appraisal and Climbing, and it is the immediate parent of the Pickpocketing access K25 now carries.
R7. Contemplative discipline is taught in houses and lineages that teach it alongside the memorised corpus and the reading of people. That is K22, not two separate direct grants.
R7. Keeping the salle's weapons is part of instructing in them. Moved into M10.
R7. The scout now takes M06 outright. Reading a field is experiential, and the scout's working life is exactly the repeated forward service M06 describes, so the route states what the grant asserted.
R5. Withdrawn from the cook: a kitchen buys its produce, it does not grow it. Retained for the brewer, whose grain supply genuinely is part of the brewhouse year.
R5. The millwright's ironwork is real but it is one of the trades C03 already offers on site, so the route supplies it rather than a standing grant.
R5. Retained where the drawn or lettered hand is the occupation: the forger, the copyist and the herald. The surveyor's draughtsmanship is Cartography, which F01 and K09 already teach.

R1/R7. Twenty-four families were told they taught apprentices purely to add a Skill. Instruction is constitutive only for the Weapon Instructor, and that case is now the M10 arms-instruction practice rather than a direct grant. The master artisan reaches it through C02 and the Teacher through K07.

R2. Every occurrence was a craft Profession being told it also ran a trading business. Workshop commerce is already the fixed content of C01 and C02, and the merchant Professions reach Trade through G12.

R3. Retained where convention is the subject: the travelling merchant and the geographer meet other peoples' custom, the informant and the trickster work it, the tailor and the cook are judged by what is proper to serve or to wear, and legal custom is the advocate's material.

R2/R7. Retained where judging worth is the work itself: the shipwright's and mason's material selection, the miner's ore, the steward's estate, the diver's salvage. The thief's eye for loot moved into K25 and the cook's buying into C01, in both cases as taught practice rather than a grant.
R2. No family now takes Bargaining directly. The cook's buying at market is real, but it is the ordinary trained commerce C01 already teaches, so the cook takes the route rather than the grant.
R4. The court families now reach Administration through K11, where it belongs as daily court service. Retained directly only for the building designer's site office.
R4. Retained where the past is the matter handled: what the teacher teaches, what the philosopher argues from, what the storyteller tells.
R4. Political knowledge is reached through K11 where it is genuinely part of the service.
R4. Retained only for the birth attendant, where rite around birth is an attested part of the practice rather than background knowledge.
R4. Retained where knowing the country is the service sold: the caravan guide, the courier, and the naturalist's account of where things live.

R4/R7. Retained where holding material without writing is the practice: the informant's ear, the musician's and the player's repertoire. The diviner's trained memory moved into K22, where it sits with the discipline that produces it.
R4/R7. Retained where reading the person in front of you is the work: the attendant, the midwife, the advocate and the astrologer. The diviner reaches it through K22 instead.
R4. Retained where the animal's behaviour is the subject: the hunter's quarry, the veterinary practitioner's patient, the trapmaker's target.
R5. Retained only for the distiller, whose apparatus is a mechanism they build and keep.

R5. Retained where timber is the material worked: siege-engine carriages and constructed traps. Withdrawn where it stood in for 'repairs things made of wood'. Added to P39 by the 2026-09-21 Profession-cores ruling, which makes the direct Carpentry route the carpenter's defining core: timber is not adjacent to this occupation, it is the occupation.
R5. Cordage genuinely belongs to engine crews, yards, spinners, shafts, mill hoists and traps; it was garnish on the carpenter.

R4. Retained where the plant is the raw material of the process, and restored to the cook when F22 was retired: a kitchen genuinely teaches what is available when. The farmer reaches it through the holding's own year, and the surgeon and weaver did not need it. Added to P02 by the 2026-09-21 Profession-cores ruling, which makes the direct Plant Lore route the gatherer's defining core: this is the ruling's exceptional-occupational-route case, not a breadth top-up.
R4. Retained only for the remedy maker, who treats the people who come to the shop. Veterinary, religious, athletic and instructional first aid were all arithmetic.
R4/R7. Retained for the informant, whose eye is his own stock in trade. The guard's watching moved into K24 with the rest of watch duty.
R4. Retained for the navigator, who works from and corrects charts.
R4. Reckoning is genuinely taught in navigation, trade, supply, planning, engineering, design, survey, credit and play. The geographer reaches what he needs through K09 and F01.
R4. Retained only where the teacher's subject includes it.
R4. Retained where obligation and jurisdiction are handled in the work. The scribe copies documents without pleading them, and the herald proclaims without adjudicating.
R5. Keeping stock is reached through F05 and F08 where it is genuinely taught.
R6. Both already reach it where it is earned: the guard through service, the instructor through M02 and M05.
R5. Design of buildings is the building designer's and siege engineer's practice, not the millwright's or the calculator's.
R2. Reached through G11, F12 and K21 where accounts are genuinely kept.

R5/R7. Retained for the cliff-and-tree collector. The thief's climbing moved into K25, where it is taught with what it is for. The rigged-vessel sailor reaches it through F09, and the diver works on a line rather than a face.
R4. Retained for the remedy maker's collecting trips; the fisher and diver work from a boat.

R6/R7. Marching is already what G04 and M06 describe. Stage movement and the diver's breath work are genuinely taught. The instructor's salle conditioning is not restored as a direct grant: the 2026-09-21 membership ruling removed Athletics from M10 as well, and it remains available through F04, the physical-training route that genuinely teaches it.

R2. Added by the 2026-09-21 membership ruling, which retires C03 and directs that Surveying be supplied through an existing group or a direct Profession route where setting-out is genuinely learned through the occupation. The site carpenter and the millwright are the two former C03 users with no other route to it and a genuine claim on it; the shipbuilder and the building designer are handled without a direct grant. Every other Profession that needs it reaches it through F01, F28 or K21.
R5. Retained for leather garments; the sailmaker's canvas is not tailoring.
R5. Withdrawn from the designer, whose C03 slot already offers it. Newly granted to the potter, whose kiln is built masonry, and retained for the sculptor working stone.
R3. Costume is not disguise; the thief's is.
R4. Retained where public speech carries the work: the con, the command, the rendering aloud.
R4. Retained for the farmer and the vintner, whose year turns on it.
R5. Travelling to a patient is not a taught competence; G05 supplies it where it is one.
R5. Canvas is the sailmaker's separate trade, not the shipwright's.
R5. Fitting a sail aboard does not make the sailmaker a seaman.
R5. The tailor's C01 slot already offers it where a shop genuinely works leather.
R5. Building a trap is not hunting with it; C14 supplies Trapping.
R5. Working underwater is not fishing.
R4. Painting arms to order does not teach the heraldic system; K10 and K11 do.
Restored to the historian as a direct route after the group-size review retired F16, whose only base Skill was Research.

groupBounds.reason: The general artisan apprenticeship is market craft: it charges Appraisal and Bargaining because the apprentice is being placed in a trade. That is the canonical Trades and Guilds stratum, and it exists from Society Level 2.
A master's shop taking apprentices is the guild tier of the same trade.
Worked mine and quarry workings are an organised extraction trade with a face to keep open. Prospecting is not this practice.
A sail and canvas loft exists only where there are rigged vessels to canvas.
A vineyard is a standing planted holding worked as a trade over years.
Locks and their working parts are metal trade work, and presuppose fixed premises with something worth locking.
A constructed trap-and-device practice is mechanism work, under the same requirement as the timber mechanism trade beside it. Setting a snare on a trapline is a different route and is not restricted.
An alchemical tradition and the furnished workshop it is practised in.
Map production from measured ground.
A yard laying down vessels is a timber trade with the yard behind it.
A draught team and a wheeled vehicle are a settled society's equipment. Below Society Level 2 there is neither the kept team nor the vehicle the practice is about.
A rigged vessel is a built ship with standing and running rigging. Below Society Level 2 there is nothing rigged to serve aboard. Open-boat working is a separate route and is not restricted.
Charted passage work requires charts and the conventions they are read by.
A credit house lends against written obligation that outlives the handshake.
Pleading presupposes a standing forum and a stated legal system. Customary settlement is reached through council and mediation practice, which is not restricted.

There is no standing corpus of older record, and no scholarly practice of investigating one. This is a bound on the study route, not a claim that nobody below writes: Latial Chiefdoms writes Old Italic at Society Level 2, and its written competency is reached through the Civilization, not through this route.
The still is equipment a society has to be able to make and keep.

Ore furnace and forge work is taught at a furnace and a forge. The Society Level 1 forager and ritual-tribal society runs none, so the practice has nothing to be taught at. From Society Level 2 it is ordinary work at every band: the common folk who keep the furnace are the people who learn it.
Weapon forging and servicing is the same metal trade, specialised.
Forged defences are the same metal trade, specialised. Hide and strap defences are reached through the leather workshop, which is not restricted.
Timber mechanism work is the making and keeping of machines — mill gear, windlass, lifting frame — and needs a society that builds them. Ordinary woodwork is not this practice.

Designed building, and the setting out that goes with it, is a building trade. Stone working itself is deliberately NOT restricted: the Society Level 1 society's own canonical reference is a megalithic monument.

A field surgical apprenticeship is learned where an organised force carries its wounded back to an operator. Society Level 1 fighting is not organised that way. Ordinary operative care is a separate route and is not restricted.
Reconnaissance reported for military decisions requires a force that makes them and a scouting arm it keeps.

Riding is taught on kept riding stock. The Society Level 1 forager and ritual-tribal society keeps none, so the practice has nothing to be taught on. From Society Level 2 it is ordinary work at every band: a pastoral clan's common folk ride.
Entrusted passage work presupposes regular voyages somebody is answerable for. Below Society Level 2 there is no such traffic to be entrusted with.
Command over an organised unit requires both the unit and the standing to be given it.
A records office is a standing bureaucracy keeping written record.
Trading practice is a merchant's apprenticeship in a market. Petty carrying and exchange are not this training.
Covert entry is taught against locks and fastenings, and follows the lock trade that makes them.
Scholarly study as a standing practice with a body of record behind it.
A philosophical school with a tradition to argue within.
Observation reduced by learned mathematical method. Watching the sky is not this practice.
A learned astrological tradition with a doctrine to read against.
Schooling as an establishment somebody is apprenticed into. Instruction inside a trade or a household is not this practice.
Chorography assembled and drawn as maps.
There is no heraldic office, and no armorial system for one to keep.
There is no court to serve inside.
Naturalist field study is a standing comparative practice against a collection and a record. Knowing plants and animals is reached through ordinary field routes, which are not restricted.
Documentary hands, credentials and older writing presuppose a documentary culture to imitate.
Applied calculation is kept accounts and measured ground reduced to figures.
Close-order drill exists only where there is a close-order force to drill. This is the settled model's own worked example of a curriculum that simply is not there.
Issued missile arms drilled in formation require the same formed force as close-order drill.

Campaign service is repeated exposure with a force in the field over a campaign. Below Society Level 2 there is raiding, not campaigning. Coercive service remains the other authored route to Combat Experience and is not restricted, so the competence itself is not withdrawn.
Campaign staff work is written logistics and administration behind a force.
Siege works are built against fortified places, which have to exist first.
Siege engines have to be built and kept before a crew can be trained on them.
Formal arms instruction charged together with weapon upkeep belongs to the same metal-arms trade.
Fighting from the saddle requires kept riding stock, exactly as mounted travel does.
Lance and troop drill requires kept mounts and a formed troop together.

professionRouteBounds.reason: Caravan service is the trading stratum's carrying, not simply driving a team. The team-and-vehicle practice itself stays available to common folk from Society Level 2.

The herd keeper works the clip off her own stock, and there is no kept clip below Society Level 2. The fibre-to-cloth trade itself is not restricted, so the competence is not withdrawn — only this way into it.
Escort duty away from the town needs the town and the traffic between towns. The guard's own watch and guard instruction is not restricted, so a Society Level 1 village guard is still a Guard.
Marching and camping with the force requires the force. A Society Level 1 soldier keeps her contingent fighting core and learns field living by another road.

directRouteBounds.reason: The pilot's direct teaching is chartwork and calculation, which belong to a charted, reckoning tradition. Entrusted passage work itself remains the Navigator's route from Society Level 2.
The counting house's direct teaching is calculation kept in figures. Below that the trader still learns her trade; she learns it without the arithmetic.
The commander's direct teaching is set-piece speech and siege operations, which belong with the siege practice it names. Command itself remains the Military Commander's core route.
Calculation and measured setting out, neither of which the mill trade itself requires.
Calculation, office administration and fortification, none of which the design apprenticeship itself supplies.
Courtly protocol and a stated legal system require the court and the code. Ordinary negotiation practice remains the Envoy's core route, so an envoy exists without either.
Calculation at the tables is learned method, not the play itself. The gaming-house practice is not restricted.

accessGridDivergences.subject: Scholarly, legal, fiscal, mercantile and ship-command training at the Society Level 1 Common Folk cell
accessGridDivergences.gridPosition: `societyBandSkillAccess` in `canonicalContent.json` admits it there. Its base set is a flat legacy import applied to every society, not an authored statement about what a Society Level 1 society actually teaches.
accessGridDivergences.contentV2Position: Withheld. K01, K02, K07, K21, F12, F13, F11 and G12 carry their own minimums, each with an authored reason about the institution or technology the society does not have.
accessGridDivergences.resolution: The Product Owner ruling of 2026-09-22 on #266 gives the route model authority. Scholarly, legal, fiscal, mercantile and ship-command access is NOT restored at Society Level 1 merely because the grid permits it. The grid supplied the shape of the four tiers and nothing more.
accessGridDivergences.reconciliation: Other implementation may still consume `societyBandSkillAccess` directly. Where it does, the grid's Society Level 1 base set will disagree with this model and must be reconciled against it in a later pass; nothing in this proposal rewrites the grid.

accessGridDivergences.subject: Whether a society below Society Level 3 writes at all
accessGridDivergences.gridPosition: The canonical `literacy` Skill records `societyLevel: 3`, and read as a statement about societies rather than about that one generic training route it says no society below Society Level 3 reads or writes.
accessGridDivergences.contentV2Position: Latial Chiefdoms is a Society Level 2 Civilization whose canonical record carries the written language Old Italic, and whose written competency is authored here. It is reachable at Society Level 2.
accessGridDivergences.resolution: The Product Owner ruling of 2026-09-22 on #266 holds that Latial Chiefdoms remains a writing-capable Society Level 2 Civilization using Old Italic. A generic Literacy Skill or training route may keep its own Society Level restriction — G11, K16 and F15 keep theirs — but that restriction must not suppress a Civilization's explicitly authored written-language competency. The two are separate things and are modelled separately.
accessGridDivergences.reconciliation: Other implementation may still read `skills.literacy.societyLevel` as a universal gate on written competence. Where it does, it will disagree with the Civilization-owned written competencies and must be reconciled against them later; the generic Skill's own floor is not changed here.
